column1: # FIDScript Deploy — the services a platform install publishes.
# One row per hostname the platform serves. The installer uses this to
# create the DNS records (through the operator's Cloudflare account) and
# to print the links at the end of the setup.
#   label      what it is, shown in the summary
#   hostname   the hostname relative to the platform domain. "." is the
#              apex itself; "*" is the wildcard for deployed apps.
#   target     the record's content. "IP" means the server's public IP;
#              otherwise it is a literal value.
#   when       always | <add-on id> — add-on services are only created
#   link       what the summary prints for this service. "{host}" is the
#              full hostname and "{domain}" is the platform's domain.
#              Empty means "https://{host}". It is not only a URL — SMTP
#              and IMAP are not served over HTTP, and a wildcard is a
# The hostname MUST match the router that serves it (installer/config/
# traefik/products.yml for the other products, the platform's platform.yml
# for its own). A DNS record without a matching router is a hostname that
# Two routes in products.yml have no row here on purpose: `files` and the
# `nextmavens` names point at host services of the registry stack that
# lives on its own domain, not at anything an add-on installs.
